design_requirements.name: nominal thrust or alternate sizing basis
design_requirements.selection_reason: The team working deck sizes the chamber by total mass flow and reports 3.14030 kN optimum thrust. The AEL 10 kN value remains a facility maximum, and the team has not approved this sizing basis as the baseline.

design_requirements.name: ambient/back pressure design condition
design_requirements.selection_reason: The deck labels 1 atm as an ideally expanded ground-test assumption. The exact ambient definition and conversion used in the run still require approval and raw-file confirmation.

design_requirements.name: burn duration and duty cycle
design_requirements.selection_reason: The deck derives 1.2 kg/s N2O from 24 kg divided by two 10 s tests. This is a working inventory assumption with zero N2O allocation margin, not an approved duty cycle.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: oxidizer and fuel definitions with inlet states
rpa_direct_inputs.value: N2O(L) at 288.15 K; IPA at 298.15 K; inlet pressures not recorded
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: The deck contains exact working temperatures and fluid labels, but does not record inlet pressure, IPA composition/purity, N2O phase evidence or team approval.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: chamber pressure
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: The working deck uses 3 MPa, which is below the 50 bar(a) competition maximum. Supply feasibility, transient maximum and team approval remain unverified.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: mixture ratio or component mass fractions
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: The deck uses O/F 3.0 and shows an RPA sweep from 2.5 to 4.0, but does not record the selection criterion or approval.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: nozzle inlet and exit conditions or expansion definition
rpa_direct_inputs.value: contraction area ratio Ac/At=4; exit pressure=1 atm
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: The deck calls Ac/At=4 a general value and uses ideal expansion at 1 atm. Literature applicability and the final ground-test design condition are not approved.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: sizing control selection
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: The embedded RPA screen selects total mass flow. The inventory argument fixes N2O at 1.2 kg/s and O/F 3 fixes IPA at 0.4 kg/s; the team has not approved this as the baseline.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: number of chambers
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: The embedded RPA input screen uses one chamber; no separate configuration decision record was found.

rpa_direct_inputs.name: nozzle shape selection
rpa_direct_inputs.selection_reason: The input screen leaves nozzle shape unspecified and states that RPA assumes a parabolic bell; the output reports a parabolic nozzle. A software default is not a team selection.

rpa_geometry_inputs.name: chamber length or characteristic length
rpa_geometry_inputs.selection_reason: The RPA output screenshot reports L*=1000 mm, but the deck does not provide the input screen, source or sensitivity that selected it.

rpa_geometry_inputs.name: contraction angle and contraction radii ratios
rpa_geometry_inputs.selection_reason: RPA supports these inputs; values require literature or an approved design basis and must remain provisional until reviewed.

rpa_geometry_inputs.name: bell contour parameters or conical half-angle
rpa_geometry_inputs.selection_reason: Nozzle contour assumptions require an approved source, design condition and sensitivity record.

rpa_computed_outputs.name: calculated thrust-chamber and nozzle size report
rpa_computed_outputs.value: optimum thrust 3.14030 kN; optimum Isp 200.13844 s; vacuum thrust 3.47614 kN; vacuum Isp 221.54211 s

rpa_computed_outputs.name: chamber and nozzle axial contour/dimensions
rpa_computed_outputs.value: Lc=266.53 mm; Lcyl=221.15 mm; Le=53.38 mm; parabolic nozzle; L*=1000 mm

rpa_export_capabilities.name: size and geometry results Save As ASCII
rpa_export_capabilities.notes: Documented by the RPA 2.3 user manual; actual SPACE Y export not executed.

rpa_export_capabilities.name: thrust-chamber contour export to DXF
rpa_export_capabilities.notes: Standard-edition manual documents units and dimension/contour options; local license/UI execution still needs confirmation.

separately_decided_design_items.selection_reason: Not determined by the RPA chamber/nozzle sizing output.
